definitions.explanation: A physical position of readiness, especially in martial arts, sports, or combat. The way one positions the body in preparation for action.
A mental state of readiness or a particular attitude toward something. Used figuratively to describe being prepared or on guard.
The external appearance or imposing size of a building or establishment.

notes:
The noun form of {構|かま}える (to set up, to take a stance). The reading changes from ⟦かまえ→かまう：01212_kamau⟧ to がまえ when used as a suffix in compounds like {門構|もんがま}え and ⟦{身構|みがま}え→身構え：27234_migamae⟧ (rendaku).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {構|かま}え⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とる — to take a stance/posture
- ⟦{上段|じょうだん}→上段：23042_joudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構|かま}え — high guard (kendo/martial arts)
- {中段|ちゅうだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構|かま}え — middle guard
- {門構|もんがま}え — the appearance of a gate/entrance
- ⟦{身構|みがま}え→身構え：27234_migamae⟧ — bracing oneself, being on guard

USAGE:
- In martial arts, specific stances have fixed names: ⟦{上段|じょうだん}→上段：23042_joudan⟧/{中段|ちゅうだん}/⟦{下段|げだん}→下段：25995_gedan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{構|かま}え
- As a suffix, undergoes rendaku: ⟦{心構|こころがま}え→心構え：07026_kokorogamae⟧ (mental preparedness), {門構|もんがま}え (gate appearance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧ — posture; physical body alignment, not necessarily implying readiness for action
- ⟦{態勢|たいせい}→態勢：12937_taisei⟧ — readiness, preparation; more about organizational or systemic preparedness
- ⟦{心構|こころがま}え→心構え：07026_kokorogamae⟧ — mental preparedness; specifically about psychological readiness
